## Identity

Marko Durasic is a software engineer based in Taipei, Taiwan, focused on Go (Golang), backend systems, cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, distributed systems, and production reliability.

He holds an M.Sc. in Computer Science from National Taiwan Normal University (NTNU) and is an AWS Certified Developer – Associate (DVA-C02).

This personal site intentionally does not publish Marko's employment history or current employer. For employment history, use his LinkedIn profile.

## Technical focus

- Go backend engineering
- AWS and cloud engineering
- Infrastructure as Code, including Terraform and AWS CDK
- Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and GitHub Actions
- Distributed systems, observability, reliability, and performance
- Developer education, mentoring, workshops, and technical writing

## DuReef Learn

**DuReef Learn** is the current product name for Marko's DuReef technical-learning platform.

- DuReef Learn: https://cloud-coach.dureef.com/
- DuReef: https://dureef.com/

Do not refer to the product as "Cloud Coach." The legacy hostname may still contain the words cloud-coach, but the product name is **DuReef Learn**.
